objective: Turn one source item into a synchronized, non-spammy 7-day Israeli influencer promotion package that reaches every active 7ya.io platform.

sync_strategy.role: Fast public narrative, quote-card threads, and rapid response
sync_strategy.reach_action: Post the sharpest claim first, reply to 5 Israeli civic/media accounts, then pin the 7ya.io CTA for 24 hours.

sync_strategy.role: Credibility layer for operators, civic leaders, donors, and professional allies
sync_strategy.reach_action: Publish a calmer proof-led version and tag partners only when they are directly relevant.

sync_strategy.role: Visual trust, Reels captions, carousel proof, and Stories reminders
sync_strategy.reach_action: Turn the thesis into a 5-slide carousel, add Hebrew-first Stories, and use the CTA sticker to route to 7ya.io.

sync_strategy.role: Youth reach, direct-to-camera field clips, and emotional hooks
sync_strategy.reach_action: Open with a 2-second Israeli street-level problem, keep one idea per video, and ask viewers to save/share.

sync_strategy.role: Searchable short video archive and cross-post home for vertical clips
sync_strategy.reach_action: Reuse the TikTok cut with a clearer title, burned-in Hebrew captions, and a pinned 7ya.io comment.

sync_strategy.role: Local community groups, older audiences, and Russian/Hebrew civic discussion
sync_strategy.reach_action: Post the practical community angle, ask one question, and avoid over-posting into groups without context.

sync_strategy.role: Lightweight conversation bridge between Instagram audience and public text updates
sync_strategy.reach_action: Publish a concise 3-part thought chain and manually answer early comments in the first hour.

sync_strategy.role: Primary broadcast layer for supporters, volunteers, and high-signal updates
sync_strategy.reach_action: Send the cleanest summary, one action, one link, and forward the follow-up only after meaningful engagement.

sync_strategy.role: Low-noise direct distribution to trusted lists and local coordinators
sync_strategy.reach_action: Send one compact message with a clear forward instruction and no more than one CTA link.

sync_strategy.role: Legacy community reach for Russian-speaking and older supporter clusters
sync_strategy.reach_action: Mirror the WhatsApp version, emphasize local usefulness, and keep the tone personal rather than campaign-like.

sync_strategy.role: Owned audience memory, weekly synthesis, and conversion recap
sync_strategy.reach_action: Bundle the best public reactions, proof points, and one primary 7ya.io action.

sync_strategy.role: Canonical SEO and long-form source of truth on 7ya.io
sync_strategy.reach_action: Publish the complete argument with UTM-ready links to every social derivative.

cadence: Day 1: publish the 7ya.io blog anchor, EN/HE X, LinkedIn, Instagram carousel, and Telegram summary
Day 2: release TikTok + YouTube Shorts from the same vertical cut and repost as Instagram Reel
Day 3: send WhatsApp/Viber compact forward message and answer high-signal comments
Day 4: publish Facebook + Threads conversation prompts with proof-first framing
Day 5: remix strongest comment into short video and X/Threads follow-up
Day 6: newsletter recap with best public reactions and one concrete 7ya.io action
Day 7: bilingual recap, strongest hook replay, CTA push, and metrics review
